name: dsh-mobile-ui
description: Mobile UI adaptation for the DSH web app (v3.3): on-demand only — nothing runs on wide screens; overflow containment, overlay sidebar/details, bottom-sheet pickers, two-row question/plan-review card footers, safe-area handling — driven by stable DOM data hooks plus runtime class derivation, with a console diagnostic snapshot (window.__dshMobileUi) for per-fix verification.
